# EVA标题生成器 / EVA Title Generator

Site: https://eva.dashen.wang
Primary languages: zh-CN, zh-TW, ja-JP, en-US, ko-KR
Type: five-language static website with an interactive EVA-style title cover generator and HTTP API

## Summary

EVA标题生成器 is a five-language web app for generating EVA-inspired title cover images.
The URL decides the UI language. User-entered titles are never auto-translated.
It supports article (1200×675), square (1200×1200), promo (1280×320), and additional social sizes.
The generator exports PNG, WebP, and SVG.

## Core capabilities

- Title and subtitle each stay on one centered line; long text shrinks; overflow blocks export
- Two-color EVA-style themes
- Custom mark field; empty mark draws nothing (no NERV default)
- Date defaults to Asia/Shanghai today
- PNG (lossless) and WebP (quality 1–100) export
- Public counter of successfully delivered covers
- HTTP API at /api/v1 for WordPress and other clients

## Font source and homage

The generator uses the Eva-Ming-SC font in this repository.
The site explicitly pays tribute to: https://github.com/kaonashi-tyc/Eva-Ming-Simplified

## Main pages

- / : Simplified Chinese
- /zh-tw : Traditional Chinese
- /ja : Japanese
- /en : English
- /ko : Korean
- /api-docs : API documentation (also under each locale prefix)

## Important user-facing facts

- The site is designed for non-commercial use in its current setup.
- Titles and subtitles are centered in every theme.
- Preview is scaled to fit the stage, while exports keep the selected pixel size.
- Switching language keeps the filled title and settings.
